note: The Ministry of Tinkhundla Administration and Development's 2024/25 annual report, held as an excerpt that stops in section 4. It reports Tinkhundla offices rebuilt and occupied (Kwaluseni, Lamgabhi, Ndzingeni, Sandleni; E6 million local funds in 2024/25), Service Centres at Mayiwane, Lobamba and Siphofaneni, and RSTP cyber-security training for heads of department, and states nothing on the connection, equipment or systems of any Inkhundla office. Context for the parent: it calls Tinkhundla 'local Government institutions', its mandate excludes city and town councils and town boards, and it gives no count of Tinkhundla.
